proposal.reason: Main change is removing CollNet network functionality: CollNet plugin loading/state, proxy handling, and CollNet transport implementation are deleted while keeping legacy interface compatibility slots. Additional substantive changes require kernels (CollNet device kernel paths and function-table entries removed/reserved), graph-search (CollNet graph preset/connect/search paths removed and graph wiring updated), tuning (algorithm/protocol model and external tuner fallback logic now hard-disables reserved CollNet slot), device-topology (NIC topology parsing/autodetect no longer tracks CollNet capability), and transport (generic transport/channel connection logic and transport registry no longer include CollNet).
